items.mainDefect: The disable endpoint calls replaceAll on an unvalidated backupCode value, allowing malformed input to cause a TypeError.

secondary.defect: The login authorization path also calls replaceAll on an unvalidated backupCode value.

items.mainDefect: The clipboard test checks only a toast, so it cannot detect failed writes or incorrect clipboard contents.

secondary.defect: The copy handler shows a success toast without awaiting or checking whether the clipboard write succeeds.

items.mainDefect: The missing-backup-codes login message directs locked-out users to settings they cannot access.

secondary.defect: Settings provides no way to generate backup codes without repeating the full 2FA setup.

items.mainDefect: Dismissing the backup-codes dialog without its Close button fails to notify the parent that 2FA is enabled.

secondary.defect: Dismissing the dialog also leaves its step, password, and backup codes unreset, causing stale state on reopening.

items.mainDefect: The disable endpoint does not validate the backupCode type before calling replaceAll.

secondary.defect: The login authorization path likewise lacks type validation before calling replaceAll on credentials.backupCode.
